executiveSummary: The reporting period features multiple high-urgency incidents centered on election-timed disinformation, AI-enabled phishing, and impersonation fraud. U.S. federal advisories warn that AI-generated voices, images, and videos are being leveraged to target voters, donors, election officials, and campaigns, including deepfake-enabled phishing and smishing schemes during the 2026 cycle Source Supporting Report . AP also reports AI-manipulated videos-likely foreign-linked-targeting U.S. Senate races in the immediate pre-election window View Article . Operational abuse of voice cloning continues at the local level, with a Florida sheriff's captain impersonated in extortion calls-local investigators cited roughly 40 such cases this year View Article . At the platform and influence-operations level, OpenAI reports the disruption of Russian and Iranian false-front operations using AI to fabricate personas, documents, and propaganda workflows View Article . INTERPOL launched a public-awareness campaign highlighting the risk of AI deepfake scams, signaling sustained global law-enforcement concern Source . Defensive developments include content-provenance verification guidance, handset protections against scam calls and fake-call impersonation, enterprise collaboration safeguards for deepfakes, and emerging forensic benchmarking programs Supporting Report View Article View Article Vendor Advisory . Considering the election-timed surge in synthetic-media abuse and multiple high-urgency public warnings, the overall threat environment appears to be worsening.

For election entities: Enforce out-of-band verification for sensitive requests; deploy phishing-resistant MFA; pre-register official domains and donation links. (Analyst Recommendation)
For law enforcement: Publicize callback numbers and payment policies; implement recorded-line disclaimers; monitor for spoofed caller IDs. (Analyst Recommendation)
For platforms and campaigns: Establish rapid takedown protocols and a crisis comms plan for last-minute manipulated media. (Analyst Recommendation)
For enterprises: Enable meeting participant verification, liveness checks, and media-integrity scanning; log alerts for post-incident forensics. (Analyst Recommendation)
For investigators: Preserve originals, derived reposts, and associated metadata; maintain chain-of-custody and use standardized forensic benchmarks where available. (Analyst Recommendation)
For media orgs: Integrate C2PA/SynthID checks into editorial workflows; disclose verification steps for contested media. (Analyst Recommendation)
